accountHint: This adapter needs a so called 'northbound API account' (NOT your FusionSolar app or portal login). The installer of your system or Huawei support can create it for you, or you can create it yourself in the FusionSolar web portal (System > Company Management > Northbound Management) if your account has the required permissions.
usernameHelp: User name of your northbound API account
apiHostHelp: Use the host name shown in the address bar of your browser when you are logged in to the FusionSolar web portal
apiVersionHelp: Automatic detection works for most accounts
polltimeHelp: Huawei refreshes the realtime data only every 5 minutes - 300 seconds is recommended
Wait time between API calls in seconds: Wait time between API calls in seconds
timeslotlengthHelp: Increase this value if you get quota errors (#407 / HTTP 403)
Retry API calls on call limit errors (#4: Retry API calls on call limit errors (#407 / HTTP 403)
apiRetryHelp: Up to 3 retries with increasing wait times
skipHelp: Every device needs additional API calls - skipping devices helps to stay within the API limits
